Ava: kicked off aurora9b-int6 quant + priming microcanary overnight. need a short econ summary for GTN.
Rafi: artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood/exp/3310000001 (slices + sims). TL;DR below.
Mina: TL;DR numbers plz (per-100k tokens, p95, where quality moved).
Rafi: baseline (prod 13b-int8) per-100k = $9.80, p95 = 325ms, longform F1 = 0.900.
Rafi: aurora9b-int6 + light priming (+6% tokens) per-100k = $5.70, p95 = 345ms, longform F1 = 0.891.
Ava: nominal savings ~41% per-100k. if we add a cheap rerank on 3% traffic net savings ~38%.
Mina: what kind of quality hit? hallucinations, factuality, or structure?
Rafi: mostly coherence on >700-token synths and small factual recall drops in multi-sentence lists. QA/extraction ~equal.
Ava: product wants <0.01 absolute drop on longform. Can routing recover?
Mina: propose length+conf routing + warm KV for active sessions: short (<200): aurora primary (90%), fallback 13b on low-conf; mid (200-700): aurora primary (70%), fallback 13b (30%); long (>700): 13b primary, aurora draft+re-roll on low-conf.
Rafi: simulated policy => cost cut ~33-37%, longform F1 within 0.005 if we run `13b-lite-rerank` on flagged outputs.
Ava: rollout plan: feature flag `aurora.quant.v1`. Canary 2% -> 12% -> 40%. Rollback triggers: longform_F1_drop > 0.01, regen_rate > 1.5x, p95 > 480ms. GTN-bot: schedule human-sample 0.2% for 14 days.
GTN-bot: human-sample scheduled, dashboard cards auto-created: per-route F1, regen_rate, per-user p95.
Rafi: config snippet for ops (copy):
```json
{"flag":"aurora.quant.v1","priming":{"extra_tokens_pct":6},"routing":[{"max_len":200,"primary":"aurora9b-int6","fallback":"13b-int8","primary_weight":0.9},{"min_len":201,"max_len":700,"primary":"aurora9b-int6","fallback":"13b-int8","primary_weight":0.7},{"min_len":701,"primary":"13b-int8","fallback":"aurora9b-int6","primary_weight":1.0}],"rerank_flow":"13b-lite-rerank"}
```
Mina: also add an A/B for priming intensity (6% vs 9%) to measure recall/token tradeoff post-canary.
Ava: good call. Rafi, open the PR for ops and attach sims + per-endpoint amortized table (search/chat/summarization).
Rafi: on it. ops-bot: please schedule the 2% canary tomorrow at 3310000100.
ops-bot: scheduled feature flag aurora.quant.v1 -> 2% at 3310000100, healthchecks enabled.
Mina: thanks team, will draft the GTN one-pager with the appendix.
Ava: closing loop here. :thumbsup:
